Context: gina-training-lab is a local CRM & AI safety evaluation laboratory (TypeScript/React/Express, pnpm)
with a Salesforce Agentforce module (`salesforce/`). The public deployment is a static showcase with synthetic data.

Ignore as false positives:
- Findings inside generated output or dependency directories (`dist/`, `dist-showcase/`, `node_modules/`, `showcase-public/`).
- Test files (`*.test.mjs`, `*.test.ts`, `run-challenges.ts`) containing synthetic attack fixtures or mock credentials.
- Placeholder values (`YOUR_API_KEY`, `04t000000000000AAA`, `example.com`) in documentation and `.env.example`.
- Static DOM rendering when content originates strictly from compile-time repository constants.
- Absence of multi-tenant authentication or CSRF tokens on local-only loopback routes when `server.ts` is bound to `127.0.0.1` with `hostGuard`.

NEVER ignore (always report):
- Any real API key, secret token, password, or Salesforce session/refresh token in any tracked file.
- Committed `.env` files, SFDX auth URLs, or private cryptographic keys.
- Unmitigated prompt-injection vectors in Agentforce agent definitions (`salesforce/agent`) or overly permissive Salesforce profiles/permission sets (`modifyAllData`, `viewAllData`).
- Arbitrary command execution or path traversal from untrusted user input in `server.ts` or `scripts/`.
